metadata_postgres.purpose: Separate Iceberg JDBC catalog and shared ETL control/key registry; not a third analytics comparison

runtime.artifact_verification_limit: Three runtime JARs downloaded and matched published HTTPS Maven checksums; local SHA-256 pins saved. Iceberg publishes SHA-512; PostgreSQL and Oracle artifacts publish SHA-1. Integration and restart probe passed; no dependency vulnerability audit claimed.

storage.hot: Docker named volumes on E-backed Linux VHDX
storage.input_snapshot_policy: Copy the selected standardized snapshot once into /analytics/input after checksum verification; use same copy for both branch loads; source-copy time recorded separately
storage.growth_gate: Next run requires measured projected additional footprint plus reserve; account for both Oracle slots, staging, Iceberg snapshots, index/temp and VHDX host free space

oracle.query_client: Oracle JDBC, native SQL; no Spark execution of Oracle KPI queries
oracle.load_strategy: Explicit pre-created DDL; JDBC append into isolated candidate tables with numPartitions<=2 and batchsize=1000; validation before publication; no inferred overwrite schema
oracle.stats: DBMS_STATS after accepted load, outside query timing; statistics time recorded in load totals

iceberg.table_commit: Atomic per table; not an atomic transaction spanning all 35 tables
iceberg.load_strategy: Explicit schema; full accepted candidate for first load; controlled overwrite/replacement preserving complete SCD history; incremental MERGE experiments later
iceberg.read_strategy: Each benchmark/report registers views pinned to the exact snapshot IDs in one publication manifest
iceberg.retention: Keep snapshots referenced by current/previous publications and reader leases; no automatic expiration in baseline

control.role: metadata/control only, not a competing warehouse
control.key_registry: Append-only canonical tuple->positive SK; dimensions include entity/namespace/BK/valid_from; facts use durable natural key; never allocate with row_number
control.two_oracle_slots: Candidate is inactive, unleased slot; build all tables and helper views there. Keep published slot read-only. Reader lease prevents slot reuse during a pinned query/refresh.
control.publication: Single coordinator validates both branch manifests, writes immutable publication with Oracle slot and Iceberg snapshots, then atomically changes active pointer in control transaction. This is visibility control, not distributed ACID.
control.partial_policy: Publish valid accepted set plus COMPLETE/PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE per KPI; engine failure or indeterminate cutoff is not publishable
control.unknown_missing_counts: NULL/UNKNOWN if entire input missing and expected count untrusted; never manufacture 0%/100% completeness

presentation.power_bi_baseline: Import per-publication KPI/detail exports calculated independently by each engine; one fixed publication_id and branch for entire refresh
presentation.web_baseline: Read the same published serving exports through a small API; render freshness and quality status
presentation.direct_connect_optional: Oracle connector / Spark JDBC-ODBC path requires separate connector smoke test and pinned publication context; not assumed available
presentation.timing: Engine SQL, export, BI refresh and UI latency measured separately

benchmark.input: same catalog hash, seed, canonical accepted/rejected sets, key registry and KPI contract
benchmark.cache: warm repeat baseline; no CACHE TABLE or query-result cache; container restart alone is not proven cold cache
benchmark.correctness: Exact integers/monetary values/decimal quantities and null/status semantics; ratio numerator and denominator exact, display rounding per KPI contract
benchmark.interpretation: Single host, bounded Oracle Free vs Spark; not proof of enterprise scale-out or production cost
